verdict.rationale: ReelMimic documents its concurrency limits as configurable settings: BUILDERS/MAX_AGENTS default to 6 agents per video and 12 across all projects, and up to 6 agents work on different parts of a video. It also says jobs pause when a limit is hit and can resume where they stopped. Queue behavior is not described: there is nothing on what happens when the cross-project cap is exceeded, how waiting jobs are ordered, or how multi-video batch rendering is scheduled. Missing for 10: documented queueing/ordering semantics for batch jobs, behavior when the global agent cap is saturated, throughput or rendering-time guidance for pipeline planning, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
